paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Probing accuracy with reduced training data.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, mBERT and XLM-R, as a function of training data size. The x-axis represents the train size, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, marked with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis represents accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 80 to 94. A light blue line with cross markers represents the accuracy of the mBERT model, which starts at approximately 84 and increases to around 90.5. A dark blue line with cross markers represents the accuracy of the XLM-R model, which starts at approximately 87.5 and increases to around 92. Both lines exhibit an increasing trend, with the XLM-R line consistently above the mBERT line, and both lines steady out at around a train size of 750.
